limitations: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report, October 15, 2026. Necessary numerical excerpt, reshaped by Decision OS; no EIA endorsement.

Original file is UTF-8 with BOM. Raw bytes and SHA-256 were verified before JSON parsing. Every retained value, date, revision flag and reclassification flag was resolved through its original JSON pointer.
Units are billion cubic feet, original units string retained. These are estimated end-of-period working-gas volumes in underground storage, not geological reserves, base/cushion gas, flows or prices.

Lower 48 total, five regional totals, and South Central salt/nonsalt subsets overlap. They must not be summed as eight independent quantities. South Central salt/nonsalt describe storage facility classes, not geographic regions outside South Central.

The two absolute stock dates are explicitly present in the same acquired release. No previous period is back-calculated from net change. Prior-year values, five-year averages and calculated changes are not additional reader observations in this excerpt.

Revision_flag and reclassification_flag are original publisher strings, all false for these 16 observations. They are not silently converted to booleans or treated as a certification that estimates will never be revised.

SourceInput published_at identifies the release date. The publisher HTML says 10:30 a.m. Eastern; JSON release_date midnight is only a date label and is not represented as historical exact availability. Acquired_at is the actual fetch time, not historical PIT certification.

RIGHTS=https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php; EIA-authored U.S. government data may be used and distributed with source/date acknowledgement. Separate copyrighted third-party price material hosted by EIA is outside this excerpt.

JSON, CSV and publisher HTML are representations of the same EIA survey family, not independent upstreams. Survey estimates carry sampling and nonsampling uncertainty; no issuer exposure or additive commodity basket is inferred.
